about.title: About
about.summary1: I'm a senior frontend engineer for complex production web applications — crypto and fintech exchanges, multi-role e-commerce, AI chat, dashboards, admin tools, and real-time surfaces.
about.summary2: Since 2018 I've worked primarily with React and Next.js, often owning or leading frontend architecture on demanding products. I prefer clear structure and maintainable state over buzzwords.
about.summary3: I'm comfortable with WebSocket, REST APIs, and libraries like Redux and Zustand. I'm also building with NestJS to grow into full-stack work — honestly, with real projects.
about.education: Bachelor of Software Engineering — HADAF University of Mazandaran (2015)
